title: Map Filter Controller source ownership
description: Inventory the PHP, JS, CSS, REST, preset, and Elementor control files that own Filter Controller behavior.
objective: Create a source map so later audits can point to the exact code owner instead of producing abstract design commentary.
acceptance_criteria: Every current filter type is mapped to Content controls, Style controls, PHP render output, CSS selectors, JS behavior, and preset fields.
Shared surfaces such as layout, buttons, active chips, pagination, empty/loading, and sort are mapped separately from filter types.
The map identifies code that is likely fragile against Elementor editor changes.
verification: rg-based source inventory is included in the report.
No plugin source files are changed by this task.
risks: Missing one owner file will make later analysis look complete while still leaving fragile behavior unexamined.
